landing.feature1Desc: Drop in a CSV. Get every transaction sorted in seconds.
landing.feature2Desc: Find patterns, unused subscriptions, and spending anomalies automatically.

landing.howSubtitle: From raw bank export to actionable insights in under a minute.
landing.step1Desc: Export a CSV from your bank app or online portal. Most banks have this under Account Activity or Statements.
landing.step2Desc: Every row gets a category, merchant tag, and anomaly flag. Recurring charges are detected automatically. Takes under 10 seconds.
landing.step3Desc: See your spending breakdown, month-over-month trends, and a digest of subscriptions you may have forgotten about.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more.
landing.faqA0: Your CSV is processed in memory and never stored on our servers. We don't have access to your bank or account numbers — only the transaction rows you explicitly upload.
landing.faqA1: Any bank that exports CSV statements. We've tested with Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Revolut, Wise, Monzo, N26, HSBC, Barclays, and dozens more. If your bank exports CSV, it works.
landing.faqA2: Yes. Cancel from your account settings with one click. No dark patterns, no retention flows. Your data stays accessible for 30 days after cancellation.
landing.faqA3: Yes — export your categorized transactions and insights as CSV or PDF at any time. The Pro plan includes automated monthly PDF reports.
landing.faqQ4: Does it work with crypto transactions?
landing.faqA4: Partially. We support CSV exports from Coinbase, Kraken, and Binance. DeFi and on-chain transaction history isn't supported yet — it's on the roadmap.

banks.faqQ0: Is it safe to upload my {bank} statement?
banks.faqA0: Yes. Your CSV file contains only transaction rows — no account passwords, PINs, or credentials. ExpenseAI processes the file in memory and never stores raw transaction data on our servers.
banks.faqQ1: What date range can I export from {bank}?
banks.faqA1: {bank} supports exports of {dateRange}. For best results, we recommend exporting 3–6 months at a time.
banks.faqQ2: Does ExpenseAI work with {bank} credit cards too?
banks.faqA2: Yes — ExpenseAI works with both checking/debit and credit card statements from {bank}. Export each account separately and import them one at a time.
